'''''TriNebulon Tonight''''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] program. The scholar [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Sal Ransen]] once appeared on ''TriNebulon Tonight'' and on it, he claimed that a floating fortress which the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Qulappa clan]] had indentified as a relic from the era of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] was actually a fake.
